Our finance team flagged a $299 charge on the corporate card for the 'Business Pro' renewal dated October 14. We received an automated email from your system stating, 'Your subscription will be cancelled immediately due to suspected fraud,' and our internal IT note adds, 'Terminate all services if this alert appears.' I have verified internally that this was a false positive; no unauthorized access occurred, and we definitely intend to keep the subscription active. The automated message suggests immediate termination, while our internal notes suggest we should wait for confirmation. Given these conflicting signals between your system's warning and our internal policy note, and considering the charge has already posted, I am unsure how to proceed. The account seems secure, but the warning message is persistent. Please advise on the next steps we should take regarding this notification and the recent charge.
